_comment: Player/NPC object interactions: label (button), clip (data/character_catalog.json clips), pose (sit/lie = take the position first, then the held pose), toast (feedback text), note (development hint for systems of later phases – kept visible during development on purpose). Used by InteractionService (player) and the NPC behaviour tables.
